summary: Connects to the running game's XF bridge while something demands game facts or a scripted session runs; paces commands, reconnects on a new session and closes when idle.

faults.when: No game with XF's bridge is running.
The bridge refused a command for pacing; retried within 4 s.

lifetime: While a consumer of game facts or a scripted session is active; the pipe lingers after the last.

x-friction.gap: Pacing at 18 requests a second with bursts, retries after refusal and reconnection on a new session.
x-friction.closes: Paced request sources with retries and reconnection.

x-friction.gap: The pipe stays open briefly after its last consumer.
x-friction.closes: Demand that lingers after its last consumer.
